brief.text: Reads the truck position and the pause state to choose the weather and the time of day.
Uses only g_bad_weather_factor, g_set_weather and g_set_skybox to set the weather.
Gets weather reports with HTTPS from tgftp.nws.noaa.gov. The requests contain station identifiers only.
Shows the weather, the approximate place, the stations and the update state.
Reads game.log.txt to find your profile, and reads and restores the weather setting in the config.cfg of your profiles.
